liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Debt due within one year was stable at {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, so cash on the balance sheet covers the near-term maturities without new funding, and the group issued a euro-denominated guaranteed bond under its EMTN programme maturing in 2031.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, and FCF after leases to debt dropped by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders once lease payments in financing are taken out.

Customer prepayments remain a large part of the funding base: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, while advance ticket cover eased by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, in the middle of the peer group.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: FCF after leases to debt fell by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, so less cash is left for debt holders after lease payments and capital spending.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, with net capex up {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.

Unit costs: CASK ex-fuel rose by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2024}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2024}}, with significant investment in spares made during the year to limit the time aircraft are grounded by supply-chain delays.
Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} is the weakest of the low-cost group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2024}}.
